Leilani Sirena can you get them to put that in writing on official letterhead? Because that’s 100% false according to everything I’ve seen on the AIC website and that I’ve heard from my
immigration attorney. It sounds like a bureaucrat being lazy so it could help if you document that they TOLD you to. I had a slightly similar issue in the past and it helped to be able to whip out the letter, on the embassy letterhead.
